svg.title: Project Structure Mapper
svg.desc: Project Structure Mapper. Status: Completed. Private repository. A local, read-only tool that maps a codebase's technologies, folders and ASP.NET Web Forms references into reports, with a step-by-step assistant in Portuguese for people who never used a terminal.
svg.text: Maps a codebase's structure locally, without
changing or uploading a single file.
saved outside the project, plus a ZIP
Diagram of the mapping flow, not a screenshot
